I own many items and will own more in the future.
Fits well and looks good! I’m 5’9”/160 and the medium is right for me. I love the style and color. This is the right weight jacket for colder evenings and shoulder seasons
I love the color which stands out in a crowd. It’s very comfortable and warm. The quality is very good. I’d recommend this jacket to anyone interested.

After receiving my relwen jacket and trying it on i was shocked. It fits so well and is made of such high quality materials. It is truly an amazing jacket the materials and the quality of craftsmanship is of the highest level. It will be a jacket i keep for life and it will last me the rest of my life. Ill eventually pass it down to the kiddo such a great product.
Great quality .
Replaced a TNF thermoball jacket. This one is softer, a bit warmer and has a higher collar. Great for cool mornings as is or as a laying piece. Will definitely be in use come fall/winter.
Love the styling and fit of this jacket. I wish it had a couple of inside pockets, but not a deal breaker.
Gills
Sizing was a bit long. But what bothers me is that the sleeves are not slippery.

relwen.t: Love the Windzip Jacket - and here is why!
relwen.c: “I’ve been really impressed with the Huckberry Windzip Jacket in Gas Blue. It has a great fit, feels high quality, and is lightweight while still providing the right amount of warmth. The color looks even better in person, and it’s versatile enough for everyday wear or layering on cooler days. Overall, a comfortable and well-made jacket that I’d definitely recommend. ”

relwen.t: Insulation coming out through ext. shell fabric
relwen.c: The insulation is coming out through the exterior fabric after only 3 months since i bought this jacket. It ruins the nice look to have little white fuzz coming through. If i pull the fuzz that looks like white pilling, a long strand of the insulation comes out. Seems like Relwen didn’t add an inner layer or is using cheap insulation or something. I am not happy considering the price of these jackets!

The Windzip Jacket in the Camo Fade pattern delivers a sharp balance of style and performance. It’s lightweight, stretchy, and water‑resistant, making it a solid everyday layer for unpredictable weather. The camo fade print adds a modern, understated edge without feeling loud. The insulation is minimal but effective for cool mornings or breezy commutes, and the build quality feels durable and premium. Overall, it’s a versatile jacket that looks good and moves well — ideal for travel, weekend wear, or layering.
Highly recommended
The style and quality are great.
More resilient than I thought when I first received. This jacket made it through a few days of turkey hunting with lots of crawling. No rips or anything. 10 out of 10.

relwen.t: Perfect jacket for the weather right now
relwen.c: Comfortable, stylish, pockets positioned well. Everything I could ask for when temps are low 40s to mid-60s.
Highly recommend

This coat was one of my first purchases from Huckberry and it will not be the last. Great looking coat, great quality.

relwen.t: Love it, love it, love it!!
relwen.c: This is a bit large, I’m a petite woman, but I can layer sweaters or other think jackets underneath. I like the feel of the fabric and I love double zippers. Great as a windbreaker.

Fantastic jacket. The pros are all the options it gives -Double zipper or buttons -Neck covering collar up or down (when up it does add a lot of warmth, but I don't always like things on my neck) - very comfortable Great construction and looks way more elevated than most puffers. It is heavier than sporty puffers, it will serve for outdoorsy things, but it really is not for "performance. " Style, so many wear options, comfort are the name of the game here. Warm, great fit but not too puffy. Very good build. Well worth the investment.

I had my eye on the Relwen WindZip jacket for a couple seasons, I finally decided to order one and my only regret is that I wish I would’ve ordered one sooner. It’s incredibly comfortable, looks very stylish and above all is functional. The variety of colors available now is also a huge plus!
This jacket is so warm and comfortable! Fits well, feels good, the color is great and I get compliments every time I wear it.

relwen.t: This Windzip Jacket is tremendous, believe me!!
relwen.c: Absolutely — here’s a more exaggerated Trump-style version: This jacket? Tremendous. Maybe the most tremendous jacket ever made. People are coming up to me, strong people, very smart people, and they’re saying, “Sir, this jacket is incredible. It’s powerful. It has presence. ” And they’re right. It’s got that elite, high-IQ outerwear energy that very few jackets can pull off. Very few. Maybe none. You put this thing on and suddenly you look like you know something other people don’t know. You’re not just dressed — you’re dominating the weather.

Bought for my husband and he loves it. Most impressed by how well this jacket is made. It fits well, he has a large and he is 6', 177lbs. It is versatile in that it can be worn as an inner or outer layer. Wish you made these for women, I would buy one for myself. Love the color choices.
This was a good purchase. Good materials. Feels well made. Little bit of stretch. Packs well for travel. Would recommend.

Looks like I’m a Relwen guy now. This jacket looks great and fits well - especially with sleeves longer than I’m used to seeing on jackets like this. The blue trim is a nice contrast to the dark khaki color as well. I’m 6’2”, 190 lbs and the Large size is just right for me. I’ll probably end up with a few different colors of this jacket.
Feels like it's made of recycled soda caps. It's okay, but nothing special. Very overpriced.
This is my third Winzip jacket, and I've been happy with all of them. Great fit, great style, the perfect weight. Just a classic all around.
Great jacket. It's very light weight, but is plenty warm as well. Great quality as well.
The jacket fits well, and I have already gotten compliments on it, even though I have only worn it a couple of times. I am ha[[y with my purchase.
Perfect for in between days that are not too cold or warm. The bright color helps my family find me in a crowd.
Jack all

relwen.t: Great Aesthetic Design and Weight, Poor Material Choice and Quality
relwen.c: The Relwen Windzip Jacket in Dark Khaki makes a strong first impression. It is a handsome jacket with a substantial feel, and it works especially well for early spring or milder winter days. Over the past few weeks, it has stayed in regular rotation for hikes, walks to work, and general time outdoors. In terms of styling, it does exactly what it sets out to do: it looks sporty, outdoors-oriented, and versatile enough for everyday wear. Design and aesthetics: 9/10. relwen.c: The Relwen Windzip is a gorgeous, well-made jacket. I have a Tanker, and I knew the quality would be there, which it is. However, it didn’t work out for me for a couple reasons that might be pluses for others. First, I was looking for a “light” jacket, and this one has enough insulation to keep you comfortable on colder days. Second, the elastic at the bottom helps keep you warm, but it also was just a bit too snug around my “backside. ” That’s a bit odd, as I don’t have much of a backside to speak of. I could’ve gone a size up, but that would’
Shoulder fit is too tight

relwen.t: Exactly what I had hoped for!
relwen.c: Purchased the Windzip Jacket after months of going back and forth. So glad I finally did! The jacket fits great, feels great and is just the right weight. Having originally purchased the jacket in Midnight (limited color choices) the Dark Orange became available for a split second and I purchased that one too.
Took this Jax on a recent trip to Colorado. Ideal Jac for rapidly changing weather in the mountains. Light weight easy to pack and perfect for am and pm temp drops! Love the feel!

relwen.c: for staters the sizing is off on this jackets. They run a size smaller than normal. Otherwise they are well made and super light weight. Quality of the fabric is amazing and well finish piece of apparel. Definitely is a no brainer to buy.

It was fine during try on but once I actually wore it out it didn’t work, the fit is off and not as clean as the other two. Unfortunately by the time the weather allowed me to wear it I was past my window of returning it. If you’re looking at this jacket, go with the Superfleece for similar warmth or the Tanker for more warmth.

The color on your website was not what I received. A store greeter said to me she suddenly had the urge to have sherbet ice cream after seeing the jacket lol. Positives of the jacket is it's very warm, zipper is solid.
Good fit, durable and really comfortable.

Finally talked myself into it and it’s my new favorite for the Seattle spring can’t make up its mind weather. Wind proof, warm but not too warm and handles the drizzle and occasional snow with ease.

I now own the jacket, best, and pullover (thanks, it's a cardigan!). The jacket has a really nice fit to it and the colors online are pretty accurate to the real thing. It is a little pricey but for guys that are 6'2" 190 and slim like me, its great to find something that looks good.

Used it on a trip to Japan in early March, with temperatures around 40–50°F. Great for layering, excellent fit, and very high-quality craftsmanship. I liked it so much I bought a second one in orange. Definitely a keeper.
Just buy this. Stop thinking about it. I own so many Relwen jackets and this may be my new favorite. Such great quality.
Stylish, fairly warm and I’ve received a ton of compliments on it.

Before I bought this jacket, I thought it would be a good lightweight jacket. It definitely serves that purpose however it is also a great winter jacket. The jacket itself is well made and much more substantial than I thought it would be. I've been wearing it in very cold weather and it works great. Like a few other reviews mentioned, the shoulders felt a little tight or maybe just different at first. It might just be the way the jacket is cut. Either way, the fit works well for me and it’s been a great jacket so far.

I’m tall. The jacket fits nicely with appropriate arm length and length along torso. Fits very nicely. Very happy with purchase.
Perfect mid-weight jacket. Super comfortable and looks good dressed up or down. Fits great - overall length and sleeve length are just right.
I love this jacket and it’s so practical for everyday use. It’s also versatile and the quality is great. Love this jacket.

My only real gripe is the lack of inside pockets, which would’ve made it more functional for everyday use. My go to jacket, excellent fit and quality. This is my second one, probably by additional colors next year.

This coat exceeded my expectations
Fits Perfect! Quality, As usual!!

These sport coats are absolutely my favorite. Purchased 3. Absolutely worth every penny.

My favorite jacket to wear almost every day. Wears great and fits perfect. The quality is exceptional and it dresses up or down with ease. If you are looking at it, just buy it.

Just got it this week and worked on a business trip for the first time. Really worked well for me new people and feeling confident. Traveled well on planes and look good at the end of the day. Really glad I had it on the plane as it was freezing, and I was able to button it up and close the neck. Who could ever do that with a regular blazer?

barbour.c: Great jacket. Nice slim Jacket. What was more impressive is the shipping. Went with free shipping option. Ordered Thursday night, sitting on my porch Saturday.

barbour.t: Perfect daily coat, dress up or down.

This is my favorite jacket! It can be dressed up or dressed down for a more casual look. It is fitted but order your normal jacket side.
Love this jacket. The fit is sharp without feeling tight, and it works just as well for the office as it does on the weekend. Quality is obvious.

I like everything about this jacket. Obvious quality. Fit works well for me. A timeless style that will always look good. Not a winter jacket but warm enough for spring or fall.
Amazing coat - makes me happy every time I throw it on.

Classy and warm! What more can you ask for.

Well made as you would expect from Barbour… Got caught in a rain shower over the weekend and it held up great, water rolled off like a duck’s back! Quality zippers and snaps and looks great!
The jacket is exactly as hoped for. Great styling and perfect fit.

It fit perfectly and keep me warm during cool days.

Awesome product. Top notch experience, but….

barbour.t: Great value on a Barbour Jacket
barbour.c: Love this color. Always owned the olive. Glad I got this color.

This is a great jacket, but Huckberry sent the wrong jacket. I received a Flint and Tinder flannel lined waxed trucker instead, which I promptly returned. I would have liked the Beaufort, but alas, it was not to be. A refund was issued along with an apology. Case closed.
Really happy with this jacket. And the price was awesome. Quick delivery. All around great service from Huckberry.

This is an amazing jacket with lifetime quality. From what I understand, it only gets better with age. Pockets are placed well and zipper down the center is easy to handle. The collar gives it a nice flare. It feels like it can protect well in a downpour. Its got some weight to it but I believe that is trade off for having a quality piece of garment.
Bought this coat for my 22 year old son, and he went out of his mind. . it was on sale. And between the timely shipping and fabulous deal. . . we are all happy in Charleston SC

Every bit as good as advertised. Great zipper, great liner, very well designed pockets, I especially love the small, hidden chest pocket for wallet/cell. Feels sturdy and has good freedom of movement. Damn near perfect, really. I purchased the Sage Thornberry first (had to send back for size issue) and when I went to reorder, only the Skyfoil was available. Having seen both, I much prefer the Skyfoil. Not a huge fan of the shiny, raincoat look.
Bought for my son, Huckberry shipping was fast and efficient!

Can you please make this in a lighter color? I have the waxed canvas trucker in a tall size and I’ve earned those stripes and patina. I need this or a chore coat in that lighter color to show the patina. PLEASE for if there are options for a custom-made piece please let me know.

One of the best jackets that I have ever had. It goes with everything; you can dress it up or wear it with a casual outfit. I have to order a size down, as it a relaxed fit run a little large if you are skinny person.

barbour.t: The zipper pull is on the left hand side.
barbour.c: The zipper did take some getting used to. However, its a small price to pay for the overall build quality. Everything is sturdy and fitted well together. It has been a joy to wear this fall. It’s been chilly, windy and rainy; but that’s outside the jacket. Im thankful for the hand warmer pockets and the game pouch to keep my hands free; on a daily basis. The game pouch is like a built in tote bag. The other pockets are thoughtfully placed and constructed. I can get to the inside breast pocket without unzipping the jacket. It also looks good lay

barbour.t: Classic Beaufort Wax Jacket in Rustic
barbour.c: I am very glad that I bought this jacket. I especially like that the price was discounted. But I need some advice. . . How to choose the lining size for this jacket?

Description states it is a classic Beaufort jacket, sylkoil version. However, it’s actually what’s referred to as thornproof wax jacket version. Understand the difference is how the cotton is processed prior to the application of the wax dressing. Regardless, there are differences, and this jacket was not as described. That said, Huckberry made the return very easy, and tried to rectify the situation, but there were no sylkoil versions available.
Super classic looks, versatility Keeps the wind and rain out of your inner layers
Beautiful jacket and fast delivery. I also ordered the hood as well I think it’s a must have.FYI hood sold separately and not offered on huckberry.
Great jacket. Not too heavy, but very warm. Highly recommend.

Not big enough. And I don't like that the front pockets are top-opening, not side opening. But the sleeves are not long enough. Too narrow at the shoulders and way way too boxy and voluminous in the belly/bottom. It's made for a fat belly man. Super disappointed.
So far really liking this - it’s almost a stand in for a leather jacket. Got the XL due to my wide shoulders. Just wish it was a little more tapered at the bottom. Overall it looks amazing.
Everything I expected from a Barbour jacket. The quality is impeccable and look is outstanding. It does run slim, but as expected based on the size chart.

It’s truly amazing to me how badly designed this jacket is. I am 5’8, 155lbs I wear slim shirts and pants. And the large version of this jacket doesn’t fit me! It’s way too tight under the armpits. In not really sure who they designed this for. Certainly not James Bond!
It indeed runs small. The ‘L’ fits very tight. But an ‘XL’ would have been too big. At this time it would fit me best only before breakfast🙂.

the medium is too small in the body, yet fine in the arms. . the large is a good fit in the body, but I had to have the arms re-measured and cut. Fortunately my tailor was able to save the deerskin around the cuff. Maybe this jacket fits a european man better- (they eat fewer cheeseburgers) than this American one. . . just my opinion.
The jacket shipped fast. I received everything I was supposed to. Better price than anyone else around on this particular model.

I love the look of it. The leather accents are great. It does run smaller than expected. I wear a 42 regular, 180lbs, 5’11” athletic build. The large was too small in the chest and shoulders. Also, Barbour put a plastic inner membrane for waterproofing that ends up making you significantly more likely to sweat with this on. You can hear the membrane crinkling when moving around. In what otherwise seems to be a high quality jacket, that membrane seems to be an odd design choice.
The Beacon Waxed Blazer Jacket is far beyond quality. Five Stars for sure.
All good, like the description said, it needs a size bigger. It’s a slim fit jacket.
Great, high quality, jacket for spring and fall. Great choice by Huckberry
